name: Isoria
summary: Isoria embodies contemporary refinement through a dialogue of wood and metal. Its top, clad in dark gray elm veneer with a soft matte finish, exudes natural depth and subtle texture. Drawers and columns in brushed brass tones introduce a warm metallic glow, while a finely finished interior brings quiet practicality. Balanced and poised, Isoria reflects timeless elegance shaped by contrast and harmony.
